"""Tests for handling Unicode characters with different display widths (wide characters like Japanese)."""

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseBasic:
    """Basic Japanese text alignment tests."""

    def test_japanese_text_single_column(self):
        """Japanese text in a single column should display correctly."""
        result = render([["レポート"]])
        # レポート is 4 Japanese characters, each 2 columns wide = 8 display columns
        assert result == "レポート"

    def test_japanese_text_with_ascii(self):
        """Column with Japanese text should align with ASCII columns."""
        result = render([["レポート", "notes"]], ["name", "file"])
        # First column should be wide enough for Japanese text
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header line
        assert "name" in lines[0]
        assert "file" in lines[0]
        # Data line
        assert "レポート" in lines[2]
        assert "notes" in lines[2]
        # Check alignment is preserved (all | should line up)
        assert lines[0].index("|") == lines[2].index("|")

    def test_japanese_in_first_column_mixed_with_ascii(self):
        """Columns should line up when first column has mixed Japanese and ASCII."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12], ["notes.txt", 3]],
            ["name", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All separator | should be at same position
        header_pipe_pos = lines[0].index("|")
        separator_pipe_pos = lines[1].index("|")
        data_line_1_pipe_pos = lines[2].index("|")
        data_line_2_pipe_pos = lines[3].index("|")
        
        assert header_pipe_pos == separator_pipe_pos == data_line_1_pipe_pos == data_line_2_pipe_pos

    def test_multiple_japanese_columns(self):
        """Multiple columns with Japanese text should align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "文書"], ["記事", "ファイル"]],
            ["日本語1", "日本語2"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All | separators should be at same position
        for line in lines:
            if "|" in line:
                # Every line with | should have it at consistent positions
                pass
        # Should not raise any assertion error from alignment check
        assert "|" in result


class TestJapaneseWithNumbers:
    """Tests with Japanese text and numeric columns (issue example)."""

    def test_issue_example_basic(self):
        """Basic version of the reported issue."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify that pipe positions are consistent across all lines
        pipe_positions = []
        for line in lines:
            positions = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
            pipe_positions.append(positions)
        
        # All lines should have pipes at the same positions
        for positions in pipe_positions[1:]:
            assert positions == pipe_positions[0], f"Pipe positions don't match: {pipe_positions}"

    def test_japanese_right_aligned_numbers(self):
        """Numbers should be right-aligned in column even with Japanese text in other columns."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", 12], ["notes", 3]],
            ["name", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Numbers should be right-aligned, pipes should line up
        data_lines = [lines[2], lines[3]]
        for line in data_lines:
            parts = line.split("|")
            # Second column (numbers) should be right-aligned
            assert parts[1].strip() == parts[1].strip()


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Tests for truncation with max_width and Japanese text."""

    def test_japanese_truncation_basic(self):
        """Japanese text should be truncated based on display width."""
        # レポート_2024.pdf: レ(2) ポ(2) ー(2) ト(2) _(1) 2(1) 0(1) 2(1) 4(1) .(1) p(1) d(1) f(1) = 19 display columns
        result = render([["レポート_2024.pdf"]], max_width=10)
        # Should be truncated to fit in 10 columns (9 chars + ellipsis)
        assert "…" in result
        # The truncated result should still be readable
        assert len(result) > 0

    def test_japanese_truncation_with_multiple_columns(self):
        """Truncation should work correctly with Japanese and ASCII columns."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", "short"]],
            ["name", "value"],
            max_width=10,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have truncated the long Japanese text
        assert "…" in result
        # Pipes should still align
        assert lines[0].index("|") == lines[2].index("|")

    def test_japanese_truncation_mixed_text(self):
        """Truncation should handle mixed Japanese and ASCII correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_notes_file.txt", "x"]],
            max_width=12,
        )
        # Should be truncated with ellipsis
        assert "…" in result

        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["ab"]],
            align="center",
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both lines should be same length
        assert len(lines[0]) == len(lines[1])

class TestJapaneseMaxWidth:
    """Test max_width with Japanese characters (should account for display width)."""

    def test_truncate_japanese_respects_display_width(self):
        """Truncation should respect visual width, not character count."""
        # "レポート" is 3 characters but 6 display columns
        # With max_width=5, should truncate to fit
        result = render([["レポート_2024", "x"]], max_width=5)
        
        # Verify the first column doesn't exceed visual width of 5
        lines = result.split("\n")
        first_col = lines[0].split("|")[0].rstrip()
        
        # Calculate visual width of first column
        display_width = sum(2 if _is_wide_char(c) else 1 for c in first_col)
        assert display_width <= 5, f"Display width {display_width} exceeds max_width 5"

    def test_truncate_japanese_with_ellipsis_fits(self):

        display_width = sum(2 if _is_wide_char(c) else 1 for c in first_col)
        assert display_width <= 8

        """Pure Japanese text truncation."""
        result = render([["日本語テスト", "x"]], max_width=6)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        first_col = lines[0].split("|")[0].rstrip()
        
        display_width = sum(2 if _is_wide_char(c) else 1 for c in first_col)
        assert display_width <= 6

    def test_mixed_ascii_japanese_truncation(self):
        """Truncate string with mixed ASCII and Japanese."""

        lines = result.split("\n")

# Helper function
def _is_wide_char(c: str) -> bool:
    """Check if character is wide (East Asian)."""
    import unicodedata
    return unicodedata.east_asian_width(c) in ('W', 'F')

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseCellAlignment:
    """Test that columns align correctly when cells contain Japanese characters."""

    def test_basic_japanese_alignment(self):
        """Single column with Japanese characters should maintain proper width."""
        result = render([["レポート"]], ["name"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        header_line = lines[0]
        separator_line = lines[1]
        data_line = lines[2]
        
        # All lines should have same number of display columns
        # Header and data should line up under the separator
        assert len(header_line) >= len(separator_line)
        assert len(data_line) >= len(separator_line)

    def test_japanese_with_numbers_alignment(self):
        """Japanese in first column with numbers in second should align correctly."""
        rows = [
            ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12],
            ["notes.txt", 3],
        ]
        result = render(rows, ["name", "KB"])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        
        # Find the pipe positions in header and verify they appear at same positions in data
        header_line = lines[0]
        separator_line = lines[1]
        data_lines = lines[2:]
        
        # The separator should have consistent column widths
        # All data lines should respect the same column boundaries
        for i, data_line in enumerate(data_lines):
            # Count pipes in header, separator, and data
            assert header_line.count("|") == separator_line.count("|") == data_line.count("|")

    def test_mixed_japanese_and_ascii_rows(self):
